plugins.name: pave
plugins.description: Plan a feature once across every service it touches, fix the interfaces between them, then build in parallel from self-contained task documents. spec.md and plan.md are the only sources of truth.

plugins.name: pave-installer
plugins.description: Install pave-setup for Codex or Kiro, which builds Pave natively on that platform without changing the Pave plugin.
